option_relations.rationale: The option describes cardiac arrest due to hypoxemia from COPD exacerbation, which is not the same as cardiac arrest due to acute pulmonary embolism.
The option describes a general cardiac electrical issue, which is not the same as cardiac arrest due to acute pulmonary embolism.
The option describes an acute exacerbation of COPD leading to respiratory failure, which is not the same as cardiac arrest due to acute pulmonary embolism.
The option describes an acute COPD exacerbation with respiratory failure, which is not the same as cardiac arrest due to acute pulmonary embolism.
